newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch closing debt market report.
newsitem.headline: Dutch closing debt market report.

text.p: Dutch bonds ended virtually unchanged on Friday after a lazy day on a practically deserted floor.
Dealers said volume would not pick up before the beginning of next year, although trades done today will settle in 1997 for the first time.
"Its no use talking about the new book year today. There's just nobody there, so prices for bigger trades would have been bad anyway," one dealer said.
The release of the U.S. durable goods data, showing an unexpected drop in November, and of U.S. weekly jobless claims, also below expectations, could not bring life back into the market.
"The figures? I didn't even watch them, too busy playing Risk," one dealer said.
